And whenever a stray oar bit of plank, the least chip or crumb of the boats touched his
skin, his tail swiftly drew back, and came sideways smiting the sea.
But soon, as if satisfied that his work for that time was done, he pushed his pleated
forehead through the ocean, and trailing after him the inter-tangled lines, continued his
leeward way at a traveler's methodic pace.
